title: Rostelecom executive says telecom operators and hosters take from 3% to 9% of cyberattacks on Russian infrastructure
date_note: The article gives only its publication day; the remarks were made at the Peering Forum.
geo_basis: company headquarters (not stated by the source)
summary: iXBT reported that Rostelecom senior vice president Alexey Chugunov said at the Peering Forum that telecom operators and hosting providers account for from 3% to 9% of all cyberattacks aimed at Russian infrastructure, a share he said has grown noticeably recently. He warned that peering links tie networks together, so one compromised network could be a starting point for wider spread.
plain: A Rostelecom executive said attacks on telecom operators and hosting firms are now a bigger share of all attacks than before, and that linked networks can spread the harm.
exec: Rostelecom says operators are linked by peering, so one weak network can become a risk for the whole industry (as reported by iXBT).

validation.note: Only iXBT read; Rostelecom own statement not read.

evidence.quote: На телеком-операторов и хостинг-провайдеров приходится от 3% до 9% всех кибератак
раньше доля таких атак составляла около 1%

review.note: scope: source says attacks aimed at Russian infrastructure; added to title and summary
